“I will make with you an everlasting covenant-My loving devotion promised to David”

“In that day I will restore the fallen tent of David. I will repair its gaps, restore its ruins, and rebuild it as in the days of old”
“that they may possess the remnant of Edom and all the nations that bear My name”
“After this I will return and rebuild the fallen tent of David. Its ruins I will rebuild, and I will restore it”
“so that the remnant of men may seek the Lord, and all the Gentiles who are called by My name”

concepts.name: The LORD will not abandon His people

passages.note: “For the LORD your God is a merciful God; He will not abandon you or destroy you or forget the covenant with your fathers”
“for the sake of His great name, the LORD will not abandon His people”
“For the LORD will not forsake His people; He will never abandon His heritage”
“Only if the heavens above could be measured and the foundations of the earth below searched out would I reject all of Israel's descendants because of all they have done”
“I ask then, did God reject His people? Certainly not!”
“For God's gifts and His call are irrevocable”
“Behold, I am about to do something new; even now it is coming”
“For behold, I will create new heavens and a new earth”
“in the renewal of all things”
“until the time comes for the restoration of all things”
“that the creation itself will be set free from its bondage to decay”
“and there will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain, for the former things have passed away”
“Behold, I make all things new”
“And the leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations”
“O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, for with the LORD is loving devotion, and with Him is redemption in abundance”
“plans to prosper you and not to harm you, to give you a future and a hope”
“So there is hope for your future, declares the LORD”
“Yet I call this to mind, and therefore I have hope”
“For the Lord will not cast us off forever. Even if He causes grief, He will show compassion according to His abundant loving devotion”
“make the Valley of Achor into a gateway of hope”
“By His great mercy He has given us new birth into a living hope”

themes.title: DELIVERANCE / SALVATION
themes.subtitle: Rescue, redemption and salvation in the texts' own words

concepts.name: The LORD will fight for you; the battle is the LORD's

passages.note: “Stand firm and you will see the LORD's salvation … The LORD will fight for you; you need only to be still”
“The LORD your God, who goes before you, will fight for you”
“the LORD your God Himself will fight for you”
“For the LORD your God goes with you to fight for you against your enemies”
“because the LORD your God fights for you, just as He promised”
“for the battle is the LORD's, and He will give all of you into our hands”
“for the battle does not belong to you, but to God”
“Our God will fight for us!”

concepts.name: I have come down to rescue them

passages.note: “their cry for deliverance from bondage ascended to God. So God heard their groaning”
“I have indeed seen the affliction of My people in Egypt”
“I have come down to rescue them from the hand of the Egyptians”
“I have heard the groaning of the Israelites, whom the Egyptians are enslaving”
“You saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt; You heard their cry at the Red Sea”
“I have heard their groaning and have come down to deliver them”

concepts.name: A mighty hand and an outstretched arm

passages.note: “I will redeem you with an outstretched arm and with mighty acts of judgment”
“by a strong hand and an outstretched arm”
“the LORD your God brought you out of there with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm”
“Then the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm”
“with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm”
“You brought Your people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs and wonders, with a strong hand and an outstretched arm”

concepts.name: When I see the blood, I will pass over you

passages.note: “when I see the blood, I will pass over you”
“He will see the blood on the top and sides of the doorframe and will pass over that doorway”
“who passed over the houses of the Israelites in Egypt when He struck down the Egyptians and spared our homes”
“Now at midnight the LORD struck down every firstborn male in the land of Egypt”
“but I redeem all the firstborn of my sons”
“By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of blood”

concepts.name: Through the sea on dry ground

passages.note: “the Israelites went through the sea on dry ground, with walls of water on their right and on their left”
“But the Israelites had walked through the sea on dry ground”
“But the Israelites walked through the sea on dry ground”
“You divided the sea before them, and they crossed through it on dry ground”
“He turned the sea into dry land; they passed through the waters on foot”
“He split the sea and brought them through; He set the waters upright like a wall”
“He led them through the depths as through a desert”
“By faith the people passed through the Red Sea as on dry land”

concepts.name: My strength and my song; He has become my salvation

passages.note: “The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation”
“With loving devotion You will lead the people You have redeemed”
“Sing to the LORD, for He is highly exalted; the horse and rider He has thrown into the sea”
“The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation”
“I will give You thanks, for You have answered me, and You have become my salvation”
“For the LORD GOD is my strength and my song, and He also has become my salvation”

concepts.name: Who brought you out of the land of Egypt

passages.note: “the LORD brought the Israelites out of the land of Egypt by their divisions”
“I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery”
“He brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you from the house of slavery”
“I delivered you out of the hands of Egypt and all your oppressors”
“I am the LORD your God, who brought you up out of Egypt”
“When Israel was a child, I loved him, and out of Egypt I called My son”
“And I brought you up from the land of Egypt and led you forty years in the wilderness”
“For I brought you up from the land of Egypt and redeemed you from the house of slavery”

concepts.name: As in the days when you came out of Egypt

passages.note: “There will be a highway for the remnant of His people who remain from Assyria, as there was for Israel when they came up from the land of Egypt”
“who made a road in the depths of the sea for the redeemed to cross over? So the redeemed of the LORD will return and enter Zion with singing”
“they will no longer say … who brought the Israelites up out of the land of Egypt … who brought the Israelites up out of the land of the north”
“who brought and led the descendants of the house of Israel up out of the land of the north”
“as in the day she came up out of Egypt”
“As in the days when you came out of Egypt, I will show My wonders”

concepts.name: They cried out to the LORD, and He heard

passages.note: “and you cried out to Me, did I not save you from their hands?”
“in their time of distress they cried out to You. From heaven You heard them”
“In my distress I called upon the LORD; I cried to my God for help. From His temple He heard my voice”
“This poor man called out, and the LORD heard him; He saved him from all his troubles”
“The righteous cry out, and the LORD hears; He delivers them from all their troubles”
“Call upon Me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you will honor Me”
“Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He delivered them from their distress”
“In my distress I called to the LORD, and He answered me”
“Then the LORD raised up judges, who saved them from the hands of those who plundered them”
“for the LORD was moved to pity by their groaning”
“He raised up Othniel son of Caleb's younger brother Kenaz as a deliverer to save them”
“and He raised up Ehud son of Gera, a left-handed Benjamite, as their deliverer”
“and He delivered you from the hands of your enemies on every side”
“So the LORD gave Israel a deliverer”
“The deliverers will ascend Mount Zion”
“the one whom God sent to be their ruler and redeemer”

concepts.name: From the hand of our enemies

passages.note: “That day the LORD saved Israel from the hand of the Egyptians”
“on the day the LORD had delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul”
“He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from foes too mighty for me”
“My times are in Your hands; deliver me from my enemies and from those who pursue me”
“He saved them from the hand that hated them; He redeemed them from the hand of the enemy”
“salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us”
“deliverance from hostile hands, that we may serve Him without fear”
“Nothing can hinder the LORD from saving, whether by many or by few”
“it is not by sword or spear that the LORD saves; for the battle is the LORD's”
“Some trust in chariots and others in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God”
“A horse is a vain hope for salvation; even its great strength cannot save”
“nor does my sword save me. For You save us from our enemies”
“A horse is prepared for the day of battle, but victory is of the LORD”
“not by bow or sword or war, not by horses and cavalry, but by the LORD their God”
“Not by might nor by power, but by My Spirit, says the LORD of Hosts”
“Is the LORD's arm too short?”
“It was by Your right hand, Your arm, and the light of Your face”
“His right hand and holy arm have gained Him the victory”
“Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the LORD”
“Surely the arm of the LORD is not too short to save, nor His ear too dull to hear”
“So His own arm brought salvation”
“So My arm brought Me salvation”
“Where are their gods, the rock in which they took refuge … Let them rise up and help you”
“Go and cry out to the gods you have chosen. Let them save you in your time of trouble”
“Ignorant are those who carry idols of wood and pray to a god that cannot save”
“They cry out to it, but it does not answer; it saves no one from his troubles”
“Let them rise up in your time of trouble and save you if they can”
“but these gods certainly will not save them in their time of disaster”

concepts.name: There is no Savior but Me

passages.note: “I, yes I, am the LORD, and there is no Savior but Me”
“There is no other God but Me, a righteous God and Savior; there is none but Me”
“you know no God but Me, for there is no Savior besides Me”

concepts.name: He is able to deliver us

passages.note: “Who among all the gods of these lands has delivered his land from my hand?”
“please save us from his hand, so that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that You alone, O LORD, are God”
“Then what god will be able to deliver you from my hands?”
“He is able to deliver us from the blazing fiery furnace and from your hand, O king”
“But even if He does not, let it be known to you, O king, that we will not serve your gods”
“For there is no other god who can deliver in this way”
“has your God, whom you serve continually, been able to deliver you from the lions?”
“the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from trials”
“These, O Israel, are your gods, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt!”
“He abandoned the God who made him and scorned the Rock of his salvation”
“The Israelites failed to remember the LORD their God who had delivered them from the hands of all their enemies”
“But today you have rejected your God, who saves you from all your troubles and afflictions”
“Here, O Israel, are your gods, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt”
“They did not remember His power”
“They forgot God their Savior, who did great things in Egypt”
“For you have forgotten the God of your salvation”
“Day after day you will be oppressed and plundered, with no one to save you”
“But you have forsaken Me and served other gods, so I will no longer save you”
“They cried for help, but there was no one to save them”
“But your iniquities have built barriers between you and your God”
“The harvest has passed, the summer has ended, but we have not been saved”
“They will cry out to Me, but I will not listen to them”
“So now I proclaim freedom for you … freedom to fall by sword, by plague, and by famine!”
“The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer”
“the horn of my salvation. My stronghold, my refuge, and my Savior, You save me from violence”
“for You are the God of my salvation; all day long I wait for You”
“The LORD is my light and my salvation”
“He alone is my rock and my salvation. He is my fortress”
“You are my Father, my God, the Rock of my salvation”
“Truly You are a God who hides Himself, O God of Israel, the Savior”
“But when the kindness of God our Savior and His love for mankind appeared”
“Salvation belongs to the LORD; may Your blessing be on Your people”
“The salvation of the righteous is from the LORD”
“Yet God is my King from ancient times, working salvation on the earth”
“Salvation is from the LORD!”
“Salvation to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!”
“Now have come the salvation and the power and the kingdom of our God”
“Hallelujah! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God!”

concepts.name: For the sake of His name

passages.note: “for the sake of His great name, the LORD will not abandon His people”
“deliver us and atone for our sins, for the sake of Your name”
“Yet He saved them for the sake of His name, to make His power known”
“For the sake of Your name, O LORD, revive me”
“For the sake of My name I will delay My wrath”
“Although our iniquities testify against us, O LORD, act for the sake of Your name”
“But I acted for the sake of My name, that it should not be profaned in the eyes of the nations”
“It is not for your sake that I will act, O house of Israel, but for My holy name”

concepts.name: He rescued me because He delighted in me

passages.note: “He rescued me because He delighted in me”
“He brought me out into the open; He rescued me because He delighted in me”
“let the LORD rescue him, since He delights in him”
“By this I know that You delight in me, for my enemy does not triumph over me”

concepts.name: From the mouth of the lion

passages.note: “The LORD, who delivered me from the claws of the lion and the bear, will deliver me from the hand of this Philistine”
“Save me from the mouth of the lion”
“Rescue my soul from their ravages, my precious life from these lions”
“My God sent His angel and shut the mouths of the lions”
“He delivers and rescues … for He has rescued Daniel from the power of the lions”
“So I was delivered from the mouth of the lion”
“He reached down from on high and took hold of me; He drew me out of deep waters”
“Surely when great waters rise, they will not come near”
“He lifted me up from the pit of despair, out of the miry clay”
“Save me, O God, for the waters are up to my neck”
“Rescue me from the mire and do not let me sink”
“Reach down from on high; set me free and rescue me from the deep waters”
“When you pass through the waters, I will be with you”
“For You cast me into the deep, into the heart of the seas”

concepts.name: Lord, save us! We are perishing!

passages.note: “He calmed the storm to a whisper, and the waves of the sea were hushed”
“Lord, save us! We are perishing!”
“Teacher, don't You care that we are perishing?”
“Master, Master, we are perishing!”
“Lord, save me! … Immediately Jesus reached out His hand and took hold of Peter”
“we abandoned all hope of being saved”
“In this way everyone was brought safely to land”

concepts.name: You have delivered my soul from death

passages.note: “O LORD, You pulled me up from Sheol; You spared me from descending into the Pit”
“But God will redeem my life from Sheol, for He will surely take me to Himself”
“For You have delivered my soul from death, and my feet from stumbling”
“Our God is a God of deliverance; the Lord GOD is our rescuer from death”
“who redeems your life from the Pit”
“For You have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling”
“But You raised my life from the pit, O LORD my God!”
“to the One who could save Him from death, and He was heard because of His reverence”
“How long, O LORD, how long? Turn, O LORD, and deliver my soul”
“How long, O LORD? Will You forget me forever?”
“My God, my God, why have You forsaken me? Why are You so far from saving me”
“Why, O LORD, do You reject me? Why do You hide Your face from me?”
“Even when I cry out and plead for help, He shuts out my prayer”
“How long, O LORD, must I call for help but You do not hear … but You do not save?”
“But I know that my Redeemer lives”
“O LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer”
“And they remembered that God was their Rock, that God Most High was their Redeemer”
“for their Redeemer is strong; He will take up their case against you”
“Your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel”
“Thus says the LORD, your Redeemer who formed you from the womb”
“The Redeemer will come to Zion, to those in Jacob who turn from transgression”
“You, O LORD, are our Father; our Redeemer from Everlasting is Your name”
“his nearest of kin may come and redeem what his brother has sold”
“he retains the right of redemption after he has sold himself. One of his brothers may redeem him”
“The man is a close relative. He is one of our kinsman-redeemers”
“Spread the corner of your garment over me, for you are a kinsman-redeemer”
“Blessed be the LORD, who has not left you this day without a kinsman-redeemer”
“for you have the right of redemption to buy it”
“Remember that you were slaves in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God redeemed you”
“With power You redeemed Your people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph”
“He has sent redemption to His people”
“Do not fear, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by your name; you are Mine!”
“Return to Me, for I have redeemed you”
“Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, because He has visited and redeemed His people”
“and are justified freely by His grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus”
“Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us”
“In Him we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses”
“in whom we have redemption, the forgiveness of sins”
“He gave Himself for us to redeem us from all lawlessness”
“He entered the Most Holy Place once for all by His own blood, thus securing eternal redemption”
“it was not with perishable things such as silver or gold that you were redeemed … but with the precious blood of Christ”
“by Your blood You purchased for God those from every tribe and tongue and people and nation”
“each man must pay the LORD a ransom for his life when he is counted”
“Spare him from going down to the Pit; I have found his ransom”
“No man can possibly redeem his brother or pay his ransom to God”
“I give Egypt for your ransom, Cush and Seba in your place”
“to give His life as a ransom for many”
“For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many”
“who gave Himself as a ransom for all”
“proclaim liberty in the land for all its inhabitants. It shall be your Jubilee”
“I broke the bars of your yoke and enabled you to walk in uprightness”
“He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death and broke away their chains”
“He executes justice for the oppressed and gives food to the hungry. The LORD sets the prisoners free”
“to break the chains of wickedness, to untie the cords of the yoke, to set the oppressed free and tear off every yoke”
“to proclaim liberty to the captives and freedom to the prisoners”
“I will break the yoke off their necks and tear off their bonds, and no longer will strangers enslave them”
“He has sent Me to proclaim liberty to the captives and recovery of sight to the blind, to release the oppressed”

concepts.name: Save us and gather us from the nations

passages.note: “then He will restore you from captivity and have compassion on you and gather you from all the nations”
“Save us, O God of our salvation; gather and deliver us from the nations”
“Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come from Zion!”
“Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from the nations”
“For I will surely save you out of a distant place, your descendants from the land of their captivity!”
“O LORD, save Your people, the remnant of Israel! … and gather them from the farthest parts of the earth”
“I will rescue them from all the places to which they were scattered on a day of clouds and darkness”
“I will save the lame and gather the scattered”

concepts.name: He will save His people from their sins

passages.note: “Deliver me from all my transgressions”
“Deliver me from bloodguilt, O God, the God of my salvation”
“And He will redeem Israel from all iniquity”
“I will save you from all your uncleanness”
“I will save them from all their apostasies by which they sinned, and I will cleanse them”
“because He will save His people from their sins”
“to give to His people the knowledge of salvation through the forgiveness of their sins”
“Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am the worst”

concepts.name: He bore the sin of many

passages.note: “But He was pierced for our transgressions, He was crushed for our iniquities”
“and the LORD has laid upon Him the iniquity of us all”
“My righteous Servant will justify many, and He will bear their iniquities”
“Yet He bore the sin of many and made intercession for the transgressors”
“so also Christ was offered once to bear the sins of many”
“He Himself bore our sins in His body on the tree”

concepts.name: To seek and to save the lost

passages.note: “Behold, I Myself will search for My flock and seek them out”
“I will seek the lost, bring back the strays, bind up the broken, and strengthen the weak”
“and go after the one that is lost, until he finds it?”
“For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost”
“For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through Him”
“For I have not come to judge the world, but to save the world”
“save Yourself! If You are the Son of God, come down from the cross!”
“He saved others, but He cannot save Himself”
“He saved others, but He cannot save Himself!”
“He saved others; let Him save Himself if He is the Christ of God, the Chosen One”
“If You are the King of the Jews … save Yourself!”
“Are You not the Christ? … Save Yourself and us!”
“Riches are worthless in the day of wrath, but righteousness brings deliverance from death”
“Their silver and gold cannot save them in the day of the wrath of the LORD”
“Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to deliver them on the Day of the LORD's wrath”
“Perhaps you will be sheltered on the day of the LORD's anger”
“who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?”
“how much more shall we be saved from wrath through Him!”
“Jesus our deliverer from the coming wrath”
“For God has not appointed us to suffer wrath, but to obtain salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ”
“But small is the gate and narrow the way that leads to life, and only a few find it”
“Who then can be saved? … With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible”
“With man this is impossible, but not with God. For all things are possible with God”
“will only a few people be saved? … Make every effort to enter through the narrow door”
“What is impossible with man is possible with God”

concepts.name: Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved

passages.note: “And everyone who calls on the name of the LORD will be saved”
“Then I called on the name of the LORD … O LORD, deliver my soul!”
“I will lift the cup of salvation and call on the name of the LORD”
“And everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved”
“Salvation exists in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given to men by which we must be saved”
“Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved”

concepts.name: By grace you have been saved

passages.note: “God, who is rich in mercy, made us alive with Christ even when we were dead in our trespasses. It is by grace you have been saved!”
“For it is by grace you have been saved through faith, and this not from yourselves; it is the gift of God, not by works, so that no one can boast”
“He saved us, not by the righteous deeds we had done, but according to His mercy”
“He has saved us and called us to a holy calling, not because of our works, but by His own purpose and by the grace He granted us”
“we believe it is through the grace of the Lord Jesus that we are saved, just as they are”
“And if it is by grace, then it is no longer by works”
“For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to everyone”

concepts.name: Believe in the Lord Jesus and you will be saved

passages.note: “Sirs, what must I do to be saved? … Believe in the Lord Jesus and you will be saved, you and your household”
“For with your heart you believe and are justified, and with your mouth you confess and are saved”
“that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life”
“Whoever believes in Him is not condemned”
“Your faith has saved you; go in peace”
“so that they may not believe and be saved”
“it is the power of God for salvation to everyone who believes, first to the Jew, then to the Greek”
“continue to work out your salvation with fear and trembling. For it is God who works in you to will and to act on behalf of His good purpose”
“For we are God's workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to do good works”
“What matters is faith expressing itself through love”
“if someone claims to have faith, but has no deeds? Can such faith save him?”
“So too, faith by itself, if it does not result in action, is dead”
“As you can see, a man is justified by his deeds and not by faith alone”
“Persevere in these things, for by so doing you will save both yourself and those who hear you”

concepts.name: You will repay each man according to his deeds

passages.note: “For You will repay each man according to his deeds”
“Will He not repay a man according to his deeds?”
“I, the LORD, search the heart; I examine the mind to reward a man according to his way, by what his deeds deserve”
“and then He will repay each one according to what he has done”
“will repay each one according to his deeds … To those who by perseverance in doing good seek glory, honor, and immortality, He will give eternal life”
“that each one may receive his due for the things done in the body, whether good or bad”
“My reward is with Me, to give to each one according to what he has done”

concepts.name: A man is justified by faith apart from works of the law

passages.note: “For we maintain that a man is justified by faith apart from works of the law”
“to the one who does not work, but believes in Him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is credited as righteousness”
“Therefore, since we have been justified through faith, we have peace with God”
“a man is not justified by works of the law, but by faith in Jesus Christ”
“not having my own righteousness from the law, but that which is through faith in Christ”
“Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved, but whoever does not believe will be condemned”
“Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit”
“Can anyone withhold the water to baptize these people? They have received the Holy Spirit just as we have!”
“he and all his household were baptized … So he and all his household rejoiced that they had come to believe in God”
“Get up, be baptized, and wash your sins away, calling on His name”
“For Christ did not send me to baptize, but to preach the gospel”
“having been buried with Him in baptism, you were raised with Him through your faith in the power of God”
“And this water symbolizes the baptism that now saves you also-not the removal of dirt from the body, but the pledge of a clear conscience toward God-through the resurrection of Jesus Christ”

concepts.name: Turn to Me and be saved

passages.note: “By repentance and rest you would be saved; your strength would lie in quiet confidence … but you were not willing”
“Turn to Me and be saved, all the ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other”
“For I take no pleasure in anyone's death, declares the Lord GOD. So repent and live!”
“Turn! Turn from your evil ways! For why should you die, O house of Israel?”
“But unless you repent, you too will all perish”
“Repent, then, and turn back, so that your sins may be wiped away”
“So then, God has granted even the Gentiles repentance unto life”
“Godly sorrow brings repentance that leads to salvation without regret”

concepts.name: Who wants everyone to be saved

passages.note: “God our Savior, who wants everyone to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth”
“the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, and especially of those who believe”
“not wanting anyone to perish but everyone to come to repentance”
“Do I take any pleasure in the death of the wicked? declares the Lord GOD. Wouldn't I prefer that he turn from his ways and live?”
“how often I have longed to gather your children together, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, but you were unwilling!”
“And I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw everyone to Myself”
“He now commands all people everywhere to repent”
“And let the one who is thirsty come, and the one who desires the water of life drink freely”

concepts.name: He chose us in Him before the foundation of the world

passages.note: “For He chose us in Him before the foundation of the world … He predestined us for adoption as His sons”

“The first chariot had red horses, the second black horses, the third white horses, and the fourth dappled horses”
“Go and patrol the earth”
“I looked and saw a white horse”
“Then another horse went forth. It was bright red”
“I looked and saw a black horse, and its rider held in his hand a pair of scales”
“Then I looked and saw a pale green horse. Its rider's name was Death”

concepts.name: How long, O Lord? and the blood of His servants avenged

passages.note: “How long, O LORD? Will You be angry forever?”
“make known among the nations Your vengeance for the bloodshed of Your servants”
“How long, O LORD, must I call for help but You do not hear”
“How long, O LORD of Hosts, will You withhold mercy from Jerusalem”
“How long until the fulfillment of the vision”
“for He will avenge the blood of His children”
“How long, O Lord, holy and true, until You judge those who dwell upon the earth and avenge our blood?”
“He has avenged the blood of His servants”
“His clothing was white as snow, and the hair of His head was like pure wool”
“His clothes became as white as the light”
“his clothes were white as snow”
“they will walk with Me in white … he who overcomes will be dressed in white”
“twenty-four elders dressed in white, with golden crowns on their heads”
“Then each of them was given a white robe”
“They were wearing white robes and holding palm branches in their hands”
“they have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb”

concepts.name: I will send My messenger, who will prepare the way before Me

passages.note: “Prepare the way for the LORD in the wilderness”
“Behold, I will send My messenger, who will prepare the way before Me”
“Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and awesome Day of the LORD. And he will turn the hearts of the fathers to their children”
“Behold, I will send My messenger ahead of You, who will prepare Your way before You”
“And if you are willing to accept it, he is the Elijah who was to come”
“Elijah does indeed come, and he will restore all things. But I tell you that Elijah has already come”
“Behold, I will send My messenger ahead of You, who will prepare Your way … A voice of one calling in the wilderness”
“And he will go on before the Lord in the spirit and power of Elijah, to turn the hearts of the fathers to their children”
“on the wing of the temple will come the abomination that causes desolation”
“They will abolish the daily sacrifice and set up the abomination of desolation”
“from the time the daily sacrifice is abolished and the abomination of desolation set up”
“So when you see standing in the holy place … spoken of by the prophet Daniel”
“So when you see the abomination of desolation standing where it should not be”
“How awful that day will be! None will be like it! It is the time of Jacob's distress, but he will be saved out of it”
“such as never was of old, nor will ever be in ages to come”
“There will be a time of distress, the likes of which will not have occurred from the beginning of nations until that time”
“unseen from the beginning of the world until now, and never to be seen again”
“unseen from the beginning of God's creation until now, and never to be seen again”

concepts.name: The sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light

passages.note: “The rising sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light”
“The skies will be rolled up like a scroll, and all their stars will fall”
“The sun and moon grow dark, and the stars lose their brightness”
“The sun will be turned to darkness and the moon to blood before the coming of the great and awesome Day of the LORD”
“The sun will be turned to darkness, and the moon to blood”
“The sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light; the stars will fall from the sky”
“the sun became black like sackcloth of goat hair, and the whole moon turned blood red … the stars of the sky fell to the earth”
“The sky receded like a scroll being rolled up”

concepts.name: I will shake the heavens and the earth

passages.note: “Therefore I will make the heavens tremble, and the earth will be shaken from its place”
“heaven and earth will tremble. But the LORD will be a refuge for His people”
“Once more, in a little while, I will shake the heavens and the earth, the sea and the dry land. I will shake all the nations”
“I am about to shake the heavens and the earth”
“Once more I will shake not only the earth, but heaven as well … since we are receiving an unshakable kingdom”
“and there was a great earthquake”
“a great earthquake the likes of which had not occurred since men were upon the earth”
“Go into the rocks and hide in the dust from the terror of the LORD”
“Men will flee to caves in the rocks and holes in the ground”
“Then they will say to the mountains … Fall on us!”
“they will say to the mountains … Fall on us!”
“hid in the caves and among the rocks of the mountains … Fall on us and hide us from the face of the One seated on the throne”

concepts.name: The great Day of the LORD

passages.note: “Behold, the Day of the LORD is coming”
“For the Day of the LORD is near”
“For the Day of the LORD is great and very dreadful. Who can endure it?”
“What will the Day of the LORD be for you? It will be darkness and not light”
“The great Day of the LORD is near … That day will be a day of wrath”
“For the Day of the LORD is near for all the nations”
“But who can endure the day of His coming?”
“For the great day of Their wrath has come, and who is able to withstand it?”
“put a mark on the foreheads of the men sighing and groaning over all the abominations committed there”
“until we have placed a seal on the foreheads of the servants of our God”
“only those who did not have the seal of God on their foreheads”
“to receive a mark on their right hand or on their forehead”
“who had His name and His Father's name written on their foreheads”
“They will see His face, and His name will be on their foreheads”

concepts.name: Every nation and tribe and people and tongue

passages.note: “O people of every nation and language”
“that the people of every nation and language should serve Him”
“by Your blood You purchased for God those from every tribe and tongue and people and nation”
“a multitude too large to count, from every nation and tribe and people and tongue”
“it was given authority over every tribe and people and tongue and nation”
“with the eternal gospel to proclaim to those who dwell on the earth … to every nation and tribe and tongue and people”
“What are these, my lord?”
“What are these, my lord? … Do you not know what they are?”
“What are these, my lord?”
“I asked him the true meaning of all this”
“I heard, but I did not understand … My lord, what will be the outcome of these things?”
“Son of man, can these bones come to life? … only You know”
“who are they, and where have they come from? … you know”

concepts.name: The trumpet and the ram's horn

passages.note: “a very loud blast of the ram's horn went out, so that all the people in the camp trembled”
“And in that day a great ram's horn will sound, and those who were perishing in Assyria will come forth”
“Blow the ram's horn in Zion; sound the alarm on My holy mountain!”
“And He will send out His angels with a loud trumpet call, and they will gather His elect from the four winds”
“For the trumpet will sound, the dead will be raised imperishable, and we will be changed”
“with the voice of an archangel, and with the trumpet of God”
“And I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and they were given seven trumpets”
“Then the seventh angel sounded his trumpet, and loud voices called out in heaven”

concepts.name: The altar of incense and the prayers of the saints

passages.note: “an altar of acacia wood for the burning of incense”
“a censer full of burning coals from the altar before the LORD … the cloud of incense will cover the mercy seat”
“May my prayer be set before You like incense”
“at the hour of the incense offering, the whole congregation was praying outside”
“golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints”
“another angel, who had a golden censer, came and stood at the altar … the smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of the saints, rose up before God”
“the angel took the censer, filled it with fire from the altar, and hurled it to the earth”

concepts.name: Water to blood, hail, locusts and darkness

passages.note: “all the water was turned to blood”
“So the LORD rained down hail upon the land of Egypt”
“The locusts swarmed across the land and settled over the entire territory of Egypt”
“total darkness covered all the land of Egypt for three days”
“out of the smoke, locusts descended on the earth”
“poured out his bowl into the rivers and springs of water, and they turned to blood”
“its kingdom was plunged into darkness”
“And great hailstones weighing almost a hundred pounds each rained down on them from above”

concepts.name: He lifted up his hand to heaven

passages.note: “I have raised my hand to the LORD God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth”
“For I lift up My hand to heaven and declare: As surely as I live forever”
“raised his right hand and his left hand toward heaven, and I heard him swear by Him who lives forever”
“lifted up his right hand to heaven … And he swore by Him who lives forever and ever”
“in it was a scroll … written on the front and back of it were words of lamentation, mourning, and woe”
“Eat this scroll, then go and speak to the house of Israel … So I ate, and it was as sweet as honey in my mouth”
“Your words were found, and I ate them”
“Take it and eat it … it was as sweet as honey in my mouth. But when I had eaten it, my stomach turned bitter”
“You must prophesy again about many peoples and nations and tongues and kings”
“He was standing in the gateway with a linen cord and a measuring rod in his hand”
“a man with a measuring line in his hand … To measure Jerusalem”
“Then I was given a measuring rod like a staff … Go and measure the temple of God”
“The angel who spoke with me had a golden measuring rod to measure the city and its gates and walls”

concepts.name: A time, times, and half a time; 42 months; 1,260 days

passages.note: “the saints will be given into his hand for a time, and times, and half a time”
“It will be for a time, and times, and half a time”
“they will trample the holy city for 42 months”
“they will prophesy for 1,260 days, clothed in sackcloth”
“where God had prepared a place for her to be nourished for 1,260 days”
“where she was nourished for a time, and times, and half a time”
“authority to act for 42 months”

concepts.name: The breath entered them, and they stood on their feet

passages.note: “breathed the breath of life into his nostrils, and the man became a living being”
“I will cause breath to enter you, and you will come to life”
“the breath entered them, and they came to life and stood on their feet”
“I will put My Spirit in you and you will live”
“the breath of life from God entered the two witnesses, and they stood on their feet”

concepts.name: A kingdom that will never be destroyed

passages.note: “the God of heaven will set up a kingdom that will never be destroyed”
“But the saints of the Most High will receive the kingdom and possess it forever”
“the sovereignty, dominion, and greatness of the kingdoms under all of heaven will be given to the people, the saints of the Most High”
“Do not be afraid, little flock, for your Father is pleased to give you the kingdom”
“You have made them to be a kingdom and priests to serve our God”
“The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of His Christ, and He will reign forever and ever”
“and they will reign forever and ever”

concepts.name: The great dragon, that ancient serpent

passages.note: “Now the serpent was more crafty than any beast of the field”
“And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed”
“Leviathan the coiling serpent … He will slay the dragon of the sea”
“a huge red dragon with seven heads, ten horns, and seven royal crowns on his heads”
“And the great dragon was hurled down … that ancient serpent called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world”
“He seized the dragon, that ancient serpent who is the devil and Satan”
“the devil who had deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur”
“the prince of the kingdom of Persia opposed me for twenty-one days. Then Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me”
“I must return at once to fight against the prince of Persia … except Michael your prince”
“At that time Michael, the great prince who stands watch over your people, will rise up”
“even the archangel Michael … The Lord rebuke you!”
“Then a war broke out in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon”
“the sons of God came to present themselves before the LORD, and Satan also came with them”
“Does Job fear God for nothing?”
“with Satan standing at his right hand to accuse him”
“The LORD rebukes you, Satan!”
“For the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down … he who accuses them day and night before our God”

concepts.name: But even if He does not

passages.note: “He is able to deliver us from the blazing fiery furnace … But even if He does not, let it be known to you, O king, that we will not serve your gods”
“who has sent His angel and delivered His servants who trusted in Him”
“My God sent His angel and shut the mouths of the lions”
“who shut the mouths of lions … quenched the raging fire”

“Others were tortured and refused their release, so that they might gain a better resurrection … They were stoned, they were sawed in two, they were put to death by the sword … The world was not worthy of them”
“Be faithful even unto death, and I will give you the crown of life”
“And they did not love their lives so as to shy away from death”

concepts.name: Beasts from the sea, with ten horns

passages.note: “Then four great beasts came up out of the sea … The first beast was like a lion … another beast appeared, which looked like a bear … It was like a leopard”
“It was different from all the beasts before it, and it had ten horns”
“This horn had eyes like those of a man and a mouth that spoke words of arrogance”
“this horn was waging war against the saints and prevailing against them”
“I saw a beast with ten horns and seven heads rising out of the sea”
“The beast I saw was like a leopard, with the feet of a bear and the mouth of a lion”
“The beast was given a mouth to speak arrogant and blasphemous words”
“Then the beast was permitted to wage war against the saints and to conquer them”

concepts.name: An image set up to be worshipped

passages.note: “King Nebuchadnezzar made a golden statue sixty cubits high and six cubits wide”
“you must fall down and worship the golden statue that King Nebuchadnezzar has set up … whoever does not fall down and worship will immediately be thrown into the blazing fiery furnace”
“telling them to make an image to the beast … cause all who refused to worship it to be killed”
“If anyone worships the beast and its image and receives its mark on his forehead or on his hand”
“those who had not worshiped the beast or its image”
“Fallen, fallen is Babylon! All the images of her gods lie shattered on the ground!”
“Suddenly Babylon has fallen and been shattered”
“You who dwell by many waters, rich in treasures, your end has come”
“tie a stone to it and cast it into the Euphrates … In the same way Babylon will sink and never rise again”
“Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great”
“the great prostitute, who sits on many waters … She held in her hand a golden cup full of abominations … BABYLON THE GREAT”
“Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great!”
“a mighty angel picked up a stone the size of a great millstone and cast it into the sea”

concepts.name: The cup of the wine of His wrath

passages.note: “For a cup is in the hand of the LORD, full of foaming wine mixed with spices”
“you who have drunk from the hand of the LORD the cup of His fury”
“Take from My hand this cup of the wine of wrath”
“Babylon was a gold cup in the hand of the LORD, making the whole earth drunk”
“he too will drink the wine of God's anger, poured undiluted into the cup of His wrath”
“God remembered Babylon the great and gave her the cup of the wine of the fury of His wrath”

concepts.name: Fire and sulfur, and smoke that rises forever

passages.note: “Then the LORD rained down sulfur and fire on Sodom and Gomorrah”
“he saw the smoke rising from the land like smoke from a furnace”
“her soil to sulfur … Its smoke will ascend forever”
“And the smoke of their torment rises forever and ever”
“Her smoke rises forever and ever”
“Both the beast and the false prophet were thrown alive into the fiery lake of burning sulfur”
“their place will be in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur. This is the second death”
“Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them … are on display as an example of those who sustain the punishment of eternal fire”

concepts.name: Their fire will never be quenched

passages.note: “for their worm will never die, their fire will never be quenched, and they will be a horror to all mankind”
“both will burn together, with no one to quench the flames”
“Then all people will see that I, the LORD, have kindled it; it will not be quenched”
“but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire”
“their worm never dies, and the fire is never quenched”

concepts.name: The harvest is ripe, the winepress is full

passages.note: “Swing the sickle, for the harvest is ripe. Come, trample the grapes, for the winepress is full”
“I have trodden the winepress alone”
“The harvest is the end of the age, and the harvesters are angels”
“Swing Your sickle and reap, because the time has come to harvest, for the crop of the earth is ripe”
“he threw them into the great winepress of God's wrath”
“He treads the winepress of the fury of the wrath of God the Almighty”

concepts.name: The glory of the LORD filled the house of the LORD

passages.note: “the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle … Moses was unable to enter the Tent of Meeting”
“the cloud filled the house of the LORD … For the glory of the LORD filled the house of the LORD”
“all the earth is full of His glory … and the temple was filled with smoke”
“The temple was filled with the cloud, and the court was filled with the brightness of the glory of the LORD”
“And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from His power; and no one could enter the temple”
“The kings of the earth take their stand and the rulers gather together, against the LORD and against His Anointed One”
“For I will gather all the nations for battle against Jerusalem”
“set your face against Gog of the land of Magog”
“Get ready; prepare yourself, you and all your company gathered around you”
“to assemble them for battle on the great day of God the Almighty … And they assembled the kings in the place that in Hebrew is called Armageddon”
“the beast and the kings of the earth with their armies assembled to wage war against the One seated on the horse”
“to deceive the nations in the four corners of the earth … Gog and Magog … to assemble them for battle”
“If the homeowner had known in which watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have kept watch”
“the Day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night”
“But the Day of the Lord will come like a thief”
“If you do not wake up, I will come like a thief, and you will not know the hour”
“Behold, I am coming like a thief. Blessed is the one who remains awake”

concepts.name: He removes kings and establishes them

passages.note: “He changes the times and seasons; He removes kings and establishes them”
“so that the living will know that the Most High rules over the kingdom of mankind and gives it to whom He wishes”
“For His dominion is an everlasting dominion … There is no one who can restrain His hand”
“until he acknowledged that the Most High God rules over the kingdom of mankind”
“I declare the end from the beginning, and from ancient times what is still to come”
“For God has put it into their hearts to carry out His purpose”

concepts.name: Come out of her, My people

passages.note: “Leave Babylon! Flee from the Chaldeans!”
“Depart, depart, go out from there! Touch no unclean thing”
“Flee from the midst of Babylon”
“Flee from Babylon! Escape with your lives!”
“Come out of her, My people! Save your lives”
“Come out of her, My people, so that you will not share in her sins or contract any of her plagues”
“and bound him for a thousand years … until the thousand years were complete”
“And they came to life and reigned with Christ for a thousand years”
“The rest of the dead did not come back to life until the thousand years were complete … and will reign with Him for a thousand years”
“When the thousand years are complete, Satan will be released from his prison”
“He has established His throne for judgment”
“As I continued to watch, thrones were set in place, and the Ancient of Days took His seat”
“until the Ancient of Days arrived and pronounced judgment in favor of the saints of the Most High”
“But the court will convene, and his dominion will be taken away”
“you who have followed Me will also sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel”
“Then I saw the thrones, and those seated on them had been given authority to judge”
“Then I saw a great white throne and the One seated on it. Earth and heaven fled from His presence, and no place was found for them”

concepts.name: Books were opened, and one of them was the Book of Life

passages.note: “please blot me out of the book that You have written … Whoever has sinned against Me, I will blot out of My book”
“May they be blotted out of the Book of Life”
“So a scroll of remembrance was written before Him regarding those who feared the LORD”
“The court was convened, and the books were opened”
“your people-everyone whose name is found written in the book-will be delivered”
“I will never blot out his name from the Book of Life”
“And books were opened, and one of them was the Book of Life. And the dead were judged according to their deeds”
“And if anyone was found whose name was not written in the Book of Life, he was thrown into the lake of fire”

concepts.name: Many who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake

passages.note: “Your dead will live; their bodies will rise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust!”
“many who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake, some to everlasting life, but others to shame and everlasting contempt”
“Then the wise will shine like the brightness of the heavens”
“O My people, I will open your graves and bring you up from them”
“all who are in their graves will hear His voice and come out … those who have done good to the resurrection of life, and those who have done evil to the resurrection of judgment”
“The rest of the dead did not come back to life until the thousand years were complete. This is the first resurrection”
“The sea gave up its dead, and Death and Hades gave up their dead”
“The one who overcomes will not be harmed by the second death”
“The second death has no power over them”
“Then Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death-the lake of fire”
“This is the second death”

concepts.name: Behold, I make all things new

passages.note: “Do not call to mind the former things … Behold, I am about to do something new”
“For behold, I will create new heavens and a new earth. The former things will not be remembered”
“the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, will endure before Me”
“we are looking forward to a new heaven and a new earth, where righteousness dwells”
“Then I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and earth had passed away”
“Behold, I make all things new”

concepts.name: The bride, the wife of the Lamb

passages.note: “as a bride adorns herself with her jewels”
“as a bridegroom rejoices over his bride, so your God will rejoice over you”
“For the marriage of the Lamb has come, and His bride has made herself ready”
“Blessed are those who are invited to the marriage supper of the Lamb”
“the new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband”
“Come, I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb”
“The Spirit and the bride say”

concepts.name: The dwelling place of God is with man

passages.note: “And I will make My dwelling place among you … I will walk among you and be your God, and you will be My people”
“My dwelling place will be with them; I will be their God, and they will be My people”
“from that day on the name of the city will be: THE LORD IS THERE”
“Shout for joy and be glad, O Daughter of Zion, for I am coming to dwell among you”
“the One seated on the throne will spread His tabernacle over them”
“Behold, the dwelling place of God is with man, and He will dwell with them. They will be His people”
“No longer will there be any curse. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be within the city”

concepts.name: The holy city: its gates and its foundations

passages.note: “set me on a very high mountain, on whose southern slope was a structure that resembled a city”
“the gates of the city will be named after the tribes of Israel”
“lay your foundations with sapphires … your gates of sparkling jewels”
“to a mountain great and high, and showed me the holy city of Jerusalem coming down out of heaven from God”
“twelve gates inscribed with the names of the twelve tribes of Israel … The wall of the city had twelve foundations bearing the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb”
“The city lies foursquare, with its width the same as its length”
“The foundations of the city walls were adorned with every kind of precious stone … And the twelve gates were twelve pearls”

concepts.name: Its gates will never be shut; the LORD your everlasting light

passages.note: “Your gates will always stand open; they will never be shut, day or night”
“for the LORD will be your everlasting light … and the days of your sorrow will cease”
“but when evening comes, there will be light”
“the city has no need of sun or moon to shine on it, because the glory of God illuminates the city, and the Lamb is its lamp”
“Its gates will never be shut at the end of the day, because there will be no night there”
“There will be no more night in the city … For the Lord God will shine on them”

concepts.name: The river of the water of life and the tree of life

passages.note: “in the middle of the garden were the tree of life … Now a river flowed out of Eden to water the garden”
“I saw water flowing from under the threshold of the temple toward the east”
“Their fruit will be used for food and their leaves for healing”
“a spring will flow from the house of the LORD”
“And on that day living water will flow out from Jerusalem”
“a river of the water of life, as clear as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb … the leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations”
“Blessed are those who wash their robes, so that they may have the right to the tree of life”
“Though it lingers, wait for it, since it will surely come and will not delay”
“In just a little while, He who is coming will come and will not delay”
“because the time is near”
“I am coming soon. Hold fast to what you have”
“Behold, I am coming soon. Blessed is the one who keeps the words of prophecy in this book”
“Behold, I am coming soon, and My reward is with Me”
“Yes, I am coming soon … Come, Lord Jesus!”

concepts.name: The Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last

passages.note: “I, the LORD-the first and the last-I am He”
“I am the first and I am the last, and there is no God but Me”
“I am He; I am the first, and I am the last”
“I am the Alpha and the Omega … who is and was and is to come”
“I am the First and the Last”
“I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End”
“I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End”

concepts.name: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes

passages.note: “He will swallow up death forever. The Lord GOD will wipe away the tears from every face”
“crowned with everlasting joy. Gladness and joy will overtake them, and sorrow and sighing will flee”
“They will not hunger or thirst … For He who has compassion on them will guide them and lead them beside springs of water”
“The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want … He leads me beside quiet waters”
“Never again will they hunger, and never will they thirst … For the Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd … God will wipe away every tear from their eyes”
“He will wipe away every tear from their eyes … there will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain, for the former things have passed away”

secondary.name: Hair → white like wool, white as snow
Dressed in linen, in a long robe → a belt of fine gold, a golden sash
The great statue → gold, silver, bronze, iron and clay, and a stone cut out without hands
Birds → gorged on the flesh of the mighty
Lament → over the great city: dust on their heads
Idols → which cannot see or hear
Death → longed for and not found
Fire that consumes and devours → and the sky shut
A woman in labor → gives birth to a son

themes.title: FATHER, SON AND HOLY SPIRIT (THE TRINITY)
themes.subtitle: The passages that name the Father, the Son and the Spirit together, those that say God is one, and those that speak of them side by side

concepts.name: The Father, the Son or the Lord, and the Spirit named together

passages.note: “in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit”
“The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with all of you.”
“according to the foreknowledge of God the Father and sanctified by the Spirit for obedience to Jesus Christ”

concepts.name: The Spirit descending like a dove

passages.note: “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased!”
“the Holy Spirit descended on Him in a bodily form like a dove”

concepts.name: The LORD is One; there is no other

passages.note: “Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God, the LORD is One.”
“God is One and there is no other but Him”
